name: @reedable/lliwio-css
description: Reader and interface styles shared by Reedable applications

scripts.check:uncommitted: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || (echo 'Working tree has uncommitted changes — commit or stash before changing the version.' && exit 1)
scripts.version:patch: npm run check:uncommitted && npm run version:bump -- patch
scripts.version:minor: npm run check:uncommitted && npm run version:bump -- minor
scripts.version:major: npm run check:uncommitted && npm run version:bump -- major
scripts.version:rc: npm run check:uncommitted && npm run version:bump -- rc
scripts.version:release: npm run check:uncommitted && npm run version:bump -- release
